Mathematics and Statistics

This is the foundation module on which subsequent, more specialised quantitative modules in Mathematics and Statistics are based. The module offers an overview of key mathematical methods and statistical concepts frequently applied to economics, management, finance and related areas.

Learning Objectives: to provide

+  A grounding in arithmetic and algebra & an overview of functions and the fundamentals of calculus

+  An introduction to financial mathematics

+  A basic knowledge of how to summarise, analyse and interpret data

+  An insight into the concepts of probability and the Normal distribution

+  An overview of sampling and experimentation in the social sciences

+  An introduction to modelling a linear relationship between variables
